timelines.title: Week 6 Nominees Named
timelines.message: Road Block closes. Nominated: Vamsi, Varshini, Rohit, Shalini and Aman. Captain Sudheer must also send Ram Prasad or Jhansi, who lost their tasks. He picks Ram Prasad. Thrigun nominates Rohit for losing the patience he showed in Agnipariksha. Naresh asks why Rohit saved Shalini over Charan. Vamsi nominates Shalini for wasting food and for what she said about Apoorva.

timelines.title: Rohit Warns Shalini After Thrigun
timelines.message: Thrigun rests a hand on Shalini’s shoulder. Rohit warns her that his reaction would have been worse outside the house. Shalini apologises more than once. Dakkshi keeps Shalini’s nomination and Shalini says the wildcards are targeting her. Shiva says her own game is barely visible.

timelines.title: Road Block Nominations Open
timelines.message: Each wildcard picks two original housemates. The winner names two people and the wildcard keeps only one. Shiva picks Thrigun and Rohit. Rohit wins, names Vamsi and Jhansi, and Shiva keeps Vamsi. Swetha picks Mukesh and Aman. Mukesh wins, names Aman and Shalini, and Swetha keeps Aman. Neethu picks Varshini and Shalini. Shalini wins and nominates Debjani. The list is not closed.

timelines.title: Rohit Fights Over Leftover Food
timelines.message: Thrigun, on ration, tells Shalini to eat the food kept for her or it will be shared. A wildcard takes the untouched portion. Rohit confronts Thrigun and captain Sudheer and asks who they are to decide. Neethu tells Shalini to let Rohit answer for himself. Shalini snaps at her.

timelines.title: Apoorva Evicted as Wildfire Begins
timelines.message: Star Maa confirms Apoorva is out. She has the fewest public votes in week 5 and leaves after less than three weeks, captaincy included. Before she goes she tells Rohit to drop the arrogance, calls Ram Prasad cunning, says Shalini has lost her game, calls Sudheer still innocent, and tells Aman to stop blaming others. She and Jhansi hug on the way out. Wildfire follows the same night.

timelines.title: Five Wildcards Enter
timelines.message: Wildfire brings in Shiva, Dakkshi, Neethu, Swetha and Rama Krishna. Each plays one challenger for a power and hands out safety badges. Shiva loses a pyramid task to Thrigun, and the ₹2 lakh he brought goes to the prize. Dakkshi loses to Naresh and badges Rohit and Mukesh. Neethu beats Thrigun and badges Naresh and Rohit. Swetha loses to Vamsi and badges Rohit and Naresh. Rama Krishna loses to Ram Prasad and badges Naresh and Rohit. Much of the criticism is aimed at Shalini and Rohit.

timelines.title: Charan Evicted by the House
timelines.message: After the wildcard badges, Rohit, Naresh and Mukesh are safe. Shalini and Charan are left. Nagarjuna hands the vote to the house. Only Aman saves Charan. Everyone else saves Shalini. Charan is out for the second time. On the way out he criticises Jhansi, Sudheer and Thrigun. Star Maa posts that he is out.

timelines.title: Nagarjuna’s Reality Check
timelines.message: Weekend with Nagarjuna. He plays footage of Shalini planning nominations with Agnipariksha housemates, of Apoorva shouting at Vamsi, and of Aman using abusive language about Mukesh’s mother. Jhansi breaks down after a task-rule warning and apologises. Housemates mark who should not stay: Rohit gets five votes and Charan three. Rohit still rates his game 9 out of 10. Nagarjuna answers with Sudheer’s line, ‘Meluko Raja Meluko’. Thrigun and Apoorva apologise over the family comment and the Mickey Mouse remark. Nagarjuna says family talk is out of line.

timelines.title: Sudheer Becomes Captain
timelines.message: Road to Reload captaincy. Outgoing captain Varshini is kept out. The eligible housemates also drop Aman. Shalini asks Sudheer to withdraw over his health. The task is to assemble a ship, with Aman and Jhansi supporting. Sudheer wins and takes the captain’s medal.

timelines.title: Jhansi Uses Her Eviction-Free Power
timelines.message: Bottom pairs must send only one person to play for safety. Jhansi gives her slot to Mukesh, then uses her power key and comes off the nomination list. Rohit stays in danger so Shalini can play. Ram Prasad and Naresh win the fun task; Ram Prasad takes the safe spot. Naresh’s mosquito act carries the round. In one tile round the house votes Apoorva out of the game.

timelines.title: Thrigun and Aman Top Road to Reload
timelines.message: Road to Reload continues. After the rounds, Thrigun–Aman lead and are safe from the nomination cut. Ram Prasad–Naresh are second, Charan–Apoorva third, Mukesh–Jhansi fourth, Rohit–Shalini last. In Step Roll Goal the points are 100, 80, 60, 40 and 20 in that order. Rohit asks Apoorva to give him privacy. Shalini steps in and she and Apoorva fight again.

timelines.title: Newcomers Threatened as Pairs Task Starts
timelines.message: Road to Reload. Bigg Boss says new contestants are coming and that their entry can cost current housemates a place. Names are not out. First pairs task for 100 points: Charan–Apoorva first, Aman–Thrigun second, Mukesh–Jhansi third, Ram Prasad–Naresh fourth, Rohit–Shalini last. Rohit refuses to pair with Apoorva and picks Shalini. Apoorva and Shalini fight again. Varshini tells Thrigun she grew up without an emotionally supportive father and links that to her pull toward Mukesh.

timelines.title: Road to Reload Nominations Close
timelines.message: Apple race finishes: the winner nominates two, the loser one. Captain Varshini is safe. Vamsi and Sudheer have immunity. Nominated: Aman, Apoorva, Charan, Jhansi, Mukesh, Naresh, Ram Prasad, Rohit, Shalini and Thrigun. Debjani stays off the list. Sudheer roasts Rohit over the weekend door threat. Charan’s speech on celebrities versus Agnipariksha draws applause, including from Mukesh, whom he nominates.

timelines.title: Nominations Open on Old Fights
timelines.message: Road to Reload nominations begin under captain Varshini. Ram Prasad nominates Aman and Thrigun. Mukesh and Thrigun both name Apoorva. Varshini nominates Apoorva and Rohit. Shalini nominates Thrigun. Thrigun and Aman apologise for the physical tasks. Rohit tells the Agnipariksha group to pull celebrities into the vote.

timelines.title: Srishti Evicted
timelines.message: Sunday episode. Nagarjuna saves nominees until Srishti and Shalini are the bottom two. Srishti has the fewest votes and leaves. She names Mukesh, Ram Prasad and Varshini as still wearing masks. Jhansi is Star Player of the week. Next theme: Road to Reload.

timelines.title: Yellow Cards for Rohit, Thrigun and Aman
timelines.message: Nagarjuna calls Apoorva’s captaincy disastrous and questions Shalini’s language and shouting. Aman gets a yellow card for task fights. Thrigun gets one for his language at Aman, with a last warning. Nagarjuna opens the door and tells Rohit to leave over a gesture read as disrespect to Bigg Boss. Rohit apologises and stays, on a yellow card. Jhansi is praised for calming fights.

timelines.title: Varshini Takes Aman’s Captaincy
timelines.message: Star Maa confirms the Total Dominion result. Aman wins the rope-and-puzzle captaincy task. Varshini uses her unused Grab Any Win power and takes the win. She becomes captain with immunity. Housemates say Thrigun pushed her to spend the power.

timelines.title: Captaincy and Immunity Race
timelines.message: Star Maa promo: Path to Power. The captaincy and immunity race heats up before the night result. Thrigun vs Apoorva remains the split.

timelines.title: Srishti Wins Sail to Navigate
timelines.message: Total Dominion continues. Official promo frames it as Thrigun vs Apoorva. Bhairava wins the puzzle round. In Sail to Navigate, Shalini protests being benched. Apoorva falls and Thrigun disqualifies her; the round restarts. Srishti then takes Sapta Shakti’s first win and Varshini’s dagger. Debjani takes Rohit’s dagger. Rohit had handed Apoorva his dagger, saying he wants the game more than immunity. Aman is warned for removing his mic and disobeys Apoorva’s punishment.

timelines.title: Fire and Lava: Bhairava Wins Again
timelines.message: Star Maa opens the captaincy race with Fire and Lava. Bhairava (Vamsi, Ram Prasad, Aman, Rohit) beat Sapta Shakti (Thrigun, Mukesh, Srishti, Debjani). Thrigun and Aman clash; Srishti is hurt. Aman takes Debjani’s dagger. Naresh is in nominations for the first time. Shalini stealing daggers cracks the Agnipariksha group; they hug and pause the fight. Sudheer says Rohit bargained a dagger with Srishti.

timelines.title: Apoorva Captaincy and Total Dominion Chaos
timelines.message: New captain Apoorva splits the house into Team Bhairava (Jhansi, Varshini, Vamsi, Rohit, Ram Prasad, Apoorva, Aman, Sudheer) and Sapta Shakti (Shalini, Srishti, Charan, Naresh, Thrigun, Mukesh, Debjani). Spitting/slap-threat fight. Apoorva–Shalini clash. Agnipariksha commoners are in extra danger this week. Season ongoing.

timelines.title: Weekend: No Elimination After Mithilesh Walk
timelines.message: Nagarjuna addresses house drama. After Mithilesh takes the money and leaves, the weekend skip/eviction is cancelled. Heated fights continue. Apoorva’s captaincy starts messy.

timelines.title: Mithilesh Walks with ₹15 Lakh
timelines.message: Wildcard Mithilesh Reddy takes the season’s biggest temptation and walks with ₹15 lakh on about Day 20–21. Rohit’s game is called out on Weekend Ka Vaar. Shortest stay of the late entries.

timelines.title: Apoorva and Mithilesh Enter
timelines.message: Day 19–20 wildcards from Agnipariksha/temptation track. Apoorva Tungaturthy enters and later becomes captain. Mithilesh beats Ramakrishna to enter, then exits almost immediately for cash.

timelines.title: Family Letters and Public Tags
timelines.message: Emotional family-letter task. Jhansi beats Temper Vamsi for a captaincy-contender spot. Naresh’s home letter is destroyed in a harsh twist. Bigg Boss flashes public tags that shake Jhansi, Mukesh and Shalini.

timelines.title: Mukesh Temptation Makes Debjani Cry
timelines.message: Mukesh faces a temptation that wrecks his bond with Debjani. Voting buzz: Thrigun leads, Sudheer rises, Jhansi and Varshini look weak. Friendships crack after nominations.

timelines.title: Krishnudu Evicted
timelines.message: Week 2 public eviction. Krishnudu out vs Srishti in the last danger pair. Rohit breaks down; says Krishnudu’s eyes remind him of his father. Mukesh is named Star Player.

timelines.title: Nagarjuna Punishment Weekend
timelines.message: Host schools the house. Earlier he had already warned Rohit and given Thrigun a harsh punishment. Captaincy and nomination fallout dominate the stage.

timelines.title: Charan Re-Enters
timelines.message: RJ Charan, evicted mid-week in Week 1, returns around Day 11–12. Thrigun gets a noted makeover/task moment. Rohit vs Thrigun remains a core fight.

timelines.title: Power of People Captaincy
timelines.message: Week 2 theme: public picks captaincy contenders. High votes: Aman, Debjani, Jhansi, Mukesh, Ram Prasad, Rohit, Shalini, Thrigun. Audience power replaces a normal in-house captain vote.

timelines.title: Thrigun Becomes Nomination Target
timelines.message: Week 2 nominations pile onto Thrigun plus Debjani, Jhansi, Mukesh, Ram, Rohit, Shalini, Srishti, Sudheer, Varshini, Krishnudu. Alliances split along celebrity vs commoner lines.

timelines.title: First Weekend With No Public Eviction
timelines.message: After two mid-week housemate evictions, Weekend Ka Vaar does not send anyone else home. House resets into Week 2 nominations.

timelines.title: Chaitra Evicted by Housemates
timelines.message: Second mid-week housemate vote. Chaitra Rai is voted out (Day 5–6) after landing in the high-risk zone with Aman, Sudheer and Varshini.

timelines.title: Charan Mid-Week Eviction
timelines.message: Maha Pareeksha / high-risk task ends with Auto Ram Prasad vs RJ Charan. Nine housemates vote Charan out (Thrigun, Krishnudu, Sudheer, Varshini, Vamsi, Mukesh, Debjani, Naresh, Jhansi). First exit of the season; he later returns.

timelines.title: Power Keys and Hidden Powers
timelines.message: Ten special powers. Groups of four fight for Power Keys; eight winners then choose two more key holders. Secrets must stay hidden. Maha Pariksha and leader battle begin.

timelines.title: 16 Contestants Enter
timelines.message: Mix of stars and Agnipariksha 2 commoners: Debjani Modak, Thrigun (Adith Arun), Jhansi, RJ Charan, Sudheer Reddy, Aman, Shalini, Srishti, Rohit, Auto Ram Prasad, Potti Naresh, Mukesh Gowda, Temper Vamsi, Krishnudu, Chaitra Rai, Varshini Sounderajan.

timelines.title: Launch Tasks and Magic Keys
timelines.message: Debjani first in; Nagarjuna makes her assign behaviour badges. Thrigun is told to scare four people with a ghost story before Saturday. Aman gets a torn-T-shirt hole count and a secret red-dot task. Karthi and Anand Deverakonda appear. Sudeep, Vijay Sethupathi and Mohanlal send virtual wishes.

timelines.title: Bigg Boss Telugu 10 Premiere
timelines.message: Dasavatharam / Dhasavatharam season launches 7 PM on Star Maa and JioHotstar. Nagarjuna hosts again. 24x7 live on JioHotstar. Pre-show Agnipariksha 2 sent commoners into the main house. Jhansi won a golden ticket.
